controls.detail: a suppressed finding is still a finding, so a population that omits it cannot be reconciled with the register
controls.mutation: the population is rebuilt without the member an active suppression disposes of

controls.detail: a total with no member row is not a census
controls.mutation: members_recorded is cleared and the member list emptied while member_count is kept

controls.detail: a suppression is not justified because it exists
an author's own record is not a review
a token no record establishes cannot be checked
controls.mutation: the reviewer token is replaced by one no tracked record establishes

controls.detail: a permanent suppression is not a governed one
controls.mutation: the expiry is cleared and the suppression declares itself unbounded

controls.detail: a lapsed acceptance is history, not current state
controls.mutation: the expiry is moved before the evaluation date while the record still declares ACTIVE

controls.detail: a suppression covers findings it never named
controls.mutation: the authorised scope is widened to rule while the target stays an exact occurrence

controls.detail: one occurrence's disposition does not transfer to another occurrence
controls.mutation: the target is a logical identity and the authorised scope is exact, so a second exact occurrence at the same logical identity would inherit it

controls.detail: an exact identity names one artefact binding
controls.mutation: the suppression records the binding of 'src/rsa/mod.rs' and its member is bound to 'src/cmp/cmp_asn.rs'

controls.detail: an acceptance at one candidate does not govern another
controls.mutation: the candidate under evaluation is moved and the suppression keeps its recorded candidate

controls.detail: a target no population contains cannot be disposed of
controls.mutation: the target exact identity is replaced by one the population does not contain

controls.detail: an invalidated suppression is not in force
controls.mutation: the record's disposition is INVALIDATED while its other fields still look active

controls.detail: the register does not account for the population when its parts do not add up
controls.mutation: the record states two members while listing one

controls.detail: an acceptance does not survive the policy that permitted it, and invalidation deletes neither the finding nor the record
controls.mutation: the policy basis the suppression was authorised under changes, and the trigger is applied

purpose: one in-memory control per refusal code, each built from a real finding population; a control proves the refusal fires and is not a source change
